detail: NFL.com official injury report lists Ben Brown as C (Week 10, Knee, Out). A third-party chart lists him as RG; that third-party value is unverified and has been removed from the table.
reason: The official position is C. The RG value cannot be confirmed from an official source, so no reconciliation is made and no deficiency is scored.

detail: All correlation_value cells (C-01 through C-06) are left blank.
reason: Correlations must be computed from official historical data; no official pre-computed correlation values exist to cite, so none are inferred.

detail: No live spread, total, or moneyline values are populated on the site.
reason: Odds are set by individual regulated sportsbooks; there is no single official odds source. A specific sportsbook/odds feed must be connected before values can be verified.

detail: Leaderboard value cells are blank for all ranked strategies.
reason: No live performance data exists yet; rankings are pending strategy execution against a connected feed.

item: Official depth chart not found; depth ordering unverified
detail: Depth-chart ordering (starter, 2nd/3rd-string backup) is not on any official NFL source checked. https://www.nfl.com/teams/detroit-lions/depth-chart returned a 404 page on 2026-11-14. Third-party charts (ESPN, Ourlads) were checked only as leads; their names and ordering were removed from the table because they are not official.
reason: The NFL does not publish a depth chart at the URL checked. Backup-replacement claims stay blank until an official source is found.

detail: A machine-readable official player-level stats feed has not been confirmed.
reason: Team-level stats are confirmed official; player-level stats require a confirmed automatable endpoint before player-prop signals can be fully sourced.

detail: NFL.com Terms and Conditions Section 1.3 states that systematic retrieval to compile a collection/database is prohibited absent express prior written consent.
reason: No automated scraping of NFL.com should be implemented until authorized access and reuse terms are documented. Mirrors suggested F16 from the d80442c2 audit.
